messages.subject: For Eduardo Menezes | Hydrogen, major projects and government relations
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Britt,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Eduardo Menezes, Chief Executive Officer.

Air Products' hydrogen and industrial-gases portfolio depends on disciplined alignment across governments, customers, sustainability priorities and major capital projects. That interface closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I also support stakeholder governance around a major industrial renewable-energy platform and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy and industrial-transition experience might support Air Products' priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Air Products.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
